summary: The enclosure is broadly coherent and the staggered round-hole side-panel concept is present, but the side panels show conspicuous row-aligned topology seams. Several internal interface details cannot be fully established from the available exterior and focused views.

checks.description: The assembly has a coherent tower form and installed internal envelopes, but visible row-aligned artifacts across the perforated side panel prevent it from being free of obvious defects.

evidence.description: The isometric assembly view shows the overall tower and installed components, while also exposing conspicuous aligned seam artifacts on the side perforations.

checks.description: The installed motherboard envelope is visible, but these views do not directly establish standard mounting retention or accessible rear I/O.

evidence.description: The isometric view shows a motherboard-sized internal body, but mounting details and rear-I/O accessibility are not visibly proven.

checks.description: The cooler envelope is present near the side panel, but the image does not directly prove a positive intake clearance gap throughout the required envelope.

evidence.description: The focused isometric view locates the cooler relative to the perforated enclosure, but the required side-panel clearance cannot be conclusively read from the view.

checks.description: The rear GPU, mount, riser-slot body, and reserved power volume are represented, but the views do not directly verify I/O-bracket access, an unobstructed riser path, and usable cable-bend space as a complete interface.

evidence.description: The focused view shows the GPU-related fit bodies, but enclosure occlusion and overlapping envelopes prevent full visual verification of all required access and routing details.

checks.description: The PSU envelope and cradle are visible, but AC inlet accessibility, retention, airflow, and the complete cable route are not all directly demonstrated.

evidence.description: The isometric focused image supports the presence and placement of the PSU fit body, cradle, and routing volumes, but not every functional access requirement.

checks.description: A button and internal route body are modeled, but the available focused images do not clearly demonstrate both exterior finger access and a continuous unobstructed route to the motherboard header.

evidence.description: The focused isometric rendering contains the button-related geometry, but its external access and full internal endpoint are not simultaneously visible.

checks.description: Both side panels visibly use dense, regular, staggered circular-hole arrays with continuous perimeter frames and no horizontal slot pattern.

evidence.description: The orthographic side view directly shows the dense staggered circular perforations and continuous outer frame.
The opposite side view shows the matching round-hole treatment and retained perimeter border.

checks.description: The circular arrays are not visually clean: several entire rows exhibit aligned horizontal seam lines through the holes, with additional vertical split artifacts in individual holes.

evidence.description: The orthographic side image directly shows multiple row-aligned horizontal topology seams crossing the circular holes and repeated split-line artifacts.

checks.description: The top, front/rear structure, feet, and side panels form a recognizable upright ITX enclosure without obvious floating exterior parts, but the prominent side-panel seam artifacts make the exterior visually inconsistent.

evidence.description: The isometric view shows a complete upright enclosure silhouette and joined major panels, while visible side-hole artifacts contradict the required clean, consistent exterior.
The right elevation clearly exposes the repeated seam defects across the side panel despite an otherwise continuous frame and supported feet.
